arxiv-2312-11209.title: QUANTIZED DECODER IN LEARNED IMAGE COMPRESSION FOR DETERMINISTIC RECONSTRUCTION
arxiv-2312-11209.creator: Esin Koyuncu, Timofey Solovyev, Johannes Sauer, Elena Alshina, André Kaup
arxiv-2312-11209.description: Abstract Learned image compression has a problem of non-bit-exact reconstruction due to different calculations of floating point arithmetic on different devices. This paper shows a method to achieve a deterministic reconstructed image by quantizing only the decoder of the learned image compression model.

arxiv-2403-04581.title: Memristive control of plasmon-mediated nonlinear photoluminescence in Au nanowires
arxiv-2403-04581.creator: Deepak K Sharma, Adrian Agreda, Florian Dell’Ova, Konstantin Malchow, Gérard Colas-des-Francs, Erik Dujardin, Alexandre Bouhelier
arxiv-2403-04581.description: Abstract Nonlinear photoluminescence (N-PL) is a broadband photon emission arising from non-equilibrium electron distribution generated at the surface of metallic nanostructures by an ultrafast pulsed laser illumination. N-PL is sensitive to surface morphology, local electromagnetic field strength, and electronic band structure making it relevant to probe optically excited nanoscale plasmonic systems.

arxiv-2501-16303.title: RAPID: Retrieval-Augmented Parallel Inference Drafting for Text-Based Video Event Retrieval
arxiv-2501-16303.creator: Long Nguyen, Huy Nguyen, Bao Khuu, Huy Luu, Huy Le, Tuan Nguyen, Tho Quan
arxiv-2501-16303.description: Abstract Retrieving events from videos using text queries has become increasingly challenging due to the rapid growth of multimedia content. Existing methods for text-based video event retrieval often focus heavily on object-level descriptions, overlooking the crucial role of contextual information. This limitation is especially apparent when queries lack sufficient context, such as missing location details or ambiguous background elements.

arxiv-2511-16010.title: Quantum Reorientational Excitations in the Raman Spectrum of Hydrogen
arxiv-2511-16010.creator: Philip Dalladay-Simpson, Eric Edmund, Huixin Hu, Mario Santoro, Federico Aiace Gorelli
arxiv-2511-16010.description: Abstract Low-frequency Raman peaks, below 250 cm -1 , are observed in hydrogen between 2–174 GPa and 13–300 K. The origin of these features is attributed to reorientational transitions ( Δ ​ J = 0 \Delta J=0 ; Q 0 Q_{0} -branch), which shift from the Rayleigh line as anisotropic intermolecular interactions lift the m J m_{J} degeneracy.

arxiv-2512-18716.title: Extreme Nanoconfinement Reshapes the Self-Dissociation of Water
arxiv-2512-18716.creator: Chenyu Wang, Wanjian Yin, Ke Zhou
arxiv-2512-18716.description: Abstract Water’s ability to self-dissociate into H 3 O + and OH - ions is central to acid–base chemistry and bioenergetics. Recent experimental advances have enabled the confinement of water down to the nanometre scale, even to the single-molecule limit, yet how this process is altered at the extreme nanoconfinement remains unclear.

pmc-10700363.title: Long and isolated graphene nanoribbons by on-surface polymerization on Au(111)
pmc-10700363.creator: Umamahesh Thupakula, We-Hyo Soe, Christian Joachim, Erik Dujardin
pmc-10700363.description: Low electronic gap graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) are used for the fabrication of nanomaterial-based devices and, when isolated, for mono-molecular electronics experiences, for which a well-controlled length is crucial. Here, an on-surface chemistry protocol is monitored for producing long and well-isolated GNR molecular wires on an Au(111) surface.

pmc-10746871.title: Broad ligament ectopic pregnancy at 18 weeks: diagnosis and management in a resource-limited setting (a case report)
pmc-10746871.creator: Madye Ange Ngo Dingom, Jovanny Fouogue Tsuala, Junie Annick Metogo Ntsama, Wilfried Loïc Meukem Tatsipie, Diane Estelle Kamdem, Jean Marie Alima, Félix Essiben
pmc-10746871.description: Broad ligament ectopic pregnancy is a relatively rare condition described in the literature. We did not find enough data concerning this subject in Cameroon. It is therefore important to know about its existence because late management can lead to increased maternal mortality.

pmc-10774478.title: Nrf2, A Target for Precision Oncology in Cancer Prognosis and Treatment
pmc-10774478.creator: Hoang Kieu Chi Ngo, Hoang Le, Young-Joon Surh
pmc-10774478.description: Activating nuclear factor-erythroid 2-related factor (Nrf2), a master regulator of redox homeostasis, has been shown to suppress initiation of carcinogenesis in normal cells. However, this transcription factor has recently been reported to promote proliferation of some transformed or cancerous cells. In tumor cells, Nrf2 is prone to mutations that result in stabilization and concurrent accumulation of its protein product.

pmc-11288130.title: A descriptive study of the single-nucleotide polymorphisms known to affect the Tacrolimus trough concentration per dose, among a population of kidney failure patients in a tertiary hospital in Ghana
pmc-11288130.creator: Edward Kwakyi, Edmund Tetteh Nartey, Michael Kobina Otabil, Isaac Asiedu-Gyekye, Samuel Yao Ahorhorlu, Vincent Bioma, William Kudzi
pmc-11288130.description: BackgroundThe burden of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and kidney failure in Ghana is on the ascendency, with the prevalence of CKD estimated at 13.3%. Patients with CKD who progress to kidney failure require life sustaining kidney replacement therapy (KRT) which is almost exclusively available in Ghana as haemodialysis.

pmc-11391399.title: Chronic Schizophrenia Presenting With Psychogenic Polydipsia Concealing Stage IV Uterine Adenocarcinoma: A Case Report
pmc-11391399.creator: Kamayel Jaludi, Dakota Pastore, Angelo Sica
pmc-11391399.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Psychogenic polydipsia (PPD) may be commonly seen in patients suffering from schizophrenia. It remains unknown how often psychiatric illness can mask other more serious conditions. The patient is a 58-year-old female with chronic schizophrenia and PPD presenting to the emergency department (ED) with abdominal pain over a seven-year period from 2016 to 2022 with her symptoms attributed to a schizophrenia exacerbation with minimal to no diagnostic follow-up.

pmc-11509161.title: Allelic, Genotypic, and Haplotypic Analysis of Cytokine IL17A, IL17F, and Toll-like Receptor TLR4 Gene Polymorphisms in Metabolic-Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: Insights from an Exploratory Study
pmc-11509161.creator: Sorina-Cezara Coste, Olga Hilda Orășan, Angela Cozma, Vasile Negrean, Teodora Gabriela Alexescu, Mirela Georgiana Perne, George Ciulei, Adriana Corina Hangan, Roxana Liana Lucaciu, Mihaela Iancu, Lucia-Maria Procopciuc, Marcin Kosmalski, Monika Różycka-Kosmalska
pmc-11509161.description: (1) Background: Interleukin 17 (IL17) and toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) elevate the risk of metabolic and liver diseases. (2) Methods: This study’s objective was to explore the association of IL17 and TLR4 gene polymorphisms with MASLD susceptibility and test their effect on serum IL17 and TLR4 levels.

pmc-11692638.title: CLINICAL CORRELATION OF MMSE AND TAU RESULTS FROM BLOOD OR IMAGING REPORTS
pmc-11692638.creator: Surya Sunil, Malini Nair, Rui Huang, Viviana Obando, Kyra Ferreira, Jennifer Glynn, Anil Nair
pmc-11692638.description: BackgroundA novel blood test for Alzheimer pathology is now available. Abnormal tau measurements from blood or brain PET may indicate brain tau. We analyzed the correlation of Mini Mental Status Examination (MMSE) to tau results disclosed to patients in a memory clinic. ObjectivesTo assess the correlation of blood or PET tau positivity to MMSE test scores.

pmc-12450912.title: The relationship between the intraocular position of dexamethasone intravitreal implant and post-injection intraocular pressure elevation
pmc-12450912.creator: Dingxi Liu, Yue Chen, Xiaonan Fu, Yongxia Zhao, Lili Ji, Yuanyuan Qiu, Sheng Li
pmc-12450912.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the relationship between the implantation position of dexamethasone intravitreal implant (DEX-I) and post-injection intraocular pressure (IOP) elevation.MethodsThis retrospective study included 324 patients (332 eyes) who received at least one DEX-I injection between June 2020 and June 2024, with a follow-up period of at least 3 months. Patient demographics, diagnoses, and DEX-I implantation positions were recorded.

pmc-12523067.title: Global epidemiology of diarrhea among internally displaced populations and refugee camp populations an evidence-based systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12523067.creator: Gelila Yitageasu, Kassaw Chekole Adane, Amensisa Hailu Tesfaye, Tenagne Enawugaw, Lidetu Demoze
pmc-12523067.description: BackgroundDiarrhea remains a significant health burden among populations affected by inadequate water and sanitation, particularly in internally displaced persons (IDPs) and refugee camp populations. This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to quantify the global prevalence of diarrhea in these vulnerable groups. The findings will inform targeted interventions and policy decisions to mitigate the health impacts in these settings.

pmc-13223593.title: Non-apoptotic regulated cell death based prognostic risk model for colorectal cancer using machine learning guided two-step framework
pmc-13223593.creator: Avik Sengupta, Sushree Sangita Kar, Rahul Kumar
pmc-13223593.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) prognosis is severely limited by tumor heterogeneity. To address this, we leveraged the emerging role of non-apoptotic regulated cell death (NARCD) pathways to develop a two-step machine learning (ML) framework to develop a prognostic risk model. We used two largest and independent CRC patient cohorts (TCGA and E-MTAB-12862).

pmc-13264435.title: Clinical and molecular features associated with the presence of brain metastases and survival in patients with advanced thyroid cancer
pmc-13264435.creator: Carly C Barron, Thais Baccili Cury Megid, Yangqing Deng, Vijithan Sugumar, Sara Ladak, Aruz Mesci, Michael Yan, Jelena Lukovic, Monika K Krzyzanowska, Anna M Sawka, Ozgur Mete, Lucy X Ma
pmc-13264435.description: BackgroundBrain metastases in advanced thyroid cancer may be underrecognized due to lack of routine brain imaging. We characterized the clinical and molecular features, risk factors, and survival outcomes of patients with non-anaplastic follicular cell-derived thyroid carcinoma (FCDTC) with brain metastases.

pmc-13518684.title: Ozone-based interventions to mitigate Pseudomonas paracarnis-induced blue discoloration in fresh cheese

pmc-13518684.description: Blue discoloration caused by Pseudomonas spp. remains a recurring issue in fresh cheeses. uslaw-usc-t16-s1891.title: 16 U.S.C. § 1891 — Investment in United States seafood processing facilities
uslaw-usc-t16-s1891.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s1891.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 38 (Fishery Conservation And Management); Subchapter VI (Miscellaneous). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of Commerce shall work with the Small Business Administration and other Federal agencies to develop financial and other mechanisms to encourage United States investment in seafood processing facilities in the United States for fisheries that lack capacity needed to process.
